children: Adidas appears to be performing better on an underlying basis than the published figures suggest, leaving room for an upward revision of the fourth-quarter sales forecasts, analysts at Deutsche Bank say in a note. The group's current guidance sees a 7% increase in currency-neutral sales. The German sportswear group reported a robust set of numbers for the third quarter, with sales of 7.25 billion euros and operating profit of 1.01 billion euros. Shares are up 3.2% at 163.10 euros. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
